content: feature request: I'd like to be able to delete DMs to myself. I'm using the self messaging as a scratchpad [I think I saw it suggested during onboarding] and it's nice to keep things clean!
Mmm, makes sense. It's a bit tricky to manage the permission settings around this, as some organizations have data retention policies that mean they don't want any messages to be deleted.

Alya Abbott said:

Mmm, makes sense. It's a bit tricky to manage the permission settings around this, as some organizations have data retention policies that mean they don't want any messages to be deleted.

I see! It needn't be deletion in the data retention sense; for my use case, the decluttering would also be achieved by (a) "when I click this button, I [permanently hide]/[archive] this DM to myself" or (b) "when I edit a message body to the empty string, it succeeds, and consecutive empty messages in the UI are consolidated".
Have you experimented with the "Collapse message" feature in the message menu? Sounds you might want some version of that that would consolidate multiple collapsed messages in a row?
I have not! I'm usually using the mobile app and I don't think I've seen that feature
Ah, yeah, that's just a web/desktop one.
